name: engram
description: LLM-native personal knowledge brain: markdown as source of truth, DB as retrieval engine

scripts.test: pnpm --filter @engram/server run test && node desktop/scripts/tests/deps.test.js && node desktop/scripts/tests/data-dir.test.js && node installer/scripts/tests/publish-installer.test.js && node installer/scripts/tests/installer-error-capture.test.js && node installer/scripts/tests/installer-markers.test.js
scripts.build:desktop: pnpm --filter @engram/server build && pnpm --filter @engram/web build && node desktop/scripts/prepare-desktop.js && (pnpm -C desktop/server install --prod --node-linker=hoisted --ignore-workspace --no-frozen-lockfile || true) && pnpm --filter @engram/desktop dist
